notes: Ecosystem is null. The FY2025 10-K reports no clearly defined money-volume measure. Its cash equity table gives "Matched share volume (in billions) 625.7" for U.S.-listed securities in 2025, but that counts shares, not dollars, and the 10-K gives no definition of it; Nordic trading appears only as a daily average value ("Total average daily value of shares traded (in billions) $ 5.1"). Neither supports a platform-share ratio, so we did not record a measure.
